Question
========
According to Piketty, why must every society justify its inequalities?

Answerlist
----------
* Because without accepted reasons the political and social structure is in danger of collapse
* Because inequality always reduces economic growth
* Because international law requires it
* Because people are naturally envious

Solution
========
Piketty frames inequality as a question of legitimacy: unless reasons are found for it, the whole political and social structure is in danger.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
